storyDecision: Does Cinderella choose to stay or leave?
sentences: Once upon a time, there was a beautiful girl who lived with her father and her stepmother and stepsisters.
One day, her father sadly passed away, leaving her heartbroken at the mercy of the woman her father had remarried.
She became their personal maid. She was made to cook, clean, and take care of the house, while they laughed at her and ridiculed her.

hints.at the mercy of: Under the power of her stepmom

sentences: Cinderella decides to escape, run away from everyone and everything.
She stumbles across a monastery, and she decides to join the nuns there, going on to live a peaceful life surrounded by kind women.
Ending: Ran away. Press (R) to restart the game!

storyDecision: Does Cinderella accept her Godmother's help?
sentences: One night, Cinderella’s stepmother and stepsisters left her behind to tend to the house as they went to a ball to try to meet the prince.
Cinderella was disappointed, because she had also wanted to go, but she continued cleaning, without complaining.
That’s when, out of nowhere, a fairy appeared! She said she was Cinderella’s godmother, and that she would help her get ready for the ball.

hints.left her behind: Didn't take her to the ball

sentences: The fairy respects her wishes and leaves. Cinderella continues to scrub the dirty floors.
She spends her life taking care of her stepsisters and their offspring
She dies alone, her family too busy to visit her.
Ending: Died alone. Press (R) to restart the game!
“I promise you’ll love your new look!” The fairy’s excitement is contagious, and Cinderella ended up accepting her offer.
“Abracadabra!” and with a flick of her wand, the fairy transformed Cinderella’s raggedy clothes into a beautiful gown.
Cinderella beamed and thanked her godmother.
“It’s my pleasure, darling! Just remember, all the magic will fade at midnight, so make sure to be back by then!”
And so, Cinderella left in a magical carriage, into a night she would never forget.
(Chapter End)

storyDecision: Does Cinderella run away or stay at the ball?
sentences: Cinderella arrived at the ball, and everyone turned to look at her. Her family didn’t recognize her, because they had never seen her dolled up.
The prince was awestruck by Cinderella’s beauty, and he asked her to dance, while her jealous stepsisters watched.
Cinderella and the prince danced together for hours. She had stolen his heart. He asked her to come back to the palace with him, but just as he did, the clock struck midnight.

hints.dolled up: Dressed in fancy or formal clothing
hints.stolen his heart: He fell in love with her
